en.title: Toast Cake

steps.n1: Arrange the toast in a greased Pyrex dish.
steps.n2: Whisk the eggs with the yogurt, sugar, and vanilla thoroughly.
steps.n3: Cook the fresh fruit, such as pears or apples, in a pan with butter, sugar, and a little cinnamon.
steps.n4: Pour half of the mixture over the toast, followed by the cooked fruit.
steps.n5: Add another layer of toast and pour the remaining mixture over the top.
steps.n6: Bake in a medium-heat oven until cooked through.

legacySteps: Arrange the toast in a greased Pyrex dish.

Add another layer of toast and pour the remaining mixture over the top.
Bake in a medium-heat oven until cooked through.
